## De-duplicates the Outreach CRM

Keeps the **first** occurrence of each `MCS Cert Number`, deletes later ones.

Cause of the duplicates: F-R3 — the Sheets node wrote `+44XXXXXXXXXX` under `USER_ENTERED`, Google coerced it to the number `441224638888`, so `appendOrUpdate` never matched its own key and appended instead of updating.

Deletes bottom-up in merged contiguous ranges so row indices don't shift mid-operation.

**Dry run by default.** POST `{"apply": true}` to actually delete.
